from random import Random
from solution import occupancy

rng = Random(42)

    events = [[rng.randrange(-10, 11), rng.randrange(-5, 6)] for _ in range(rng.randrange(20))]

    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('expected ValueError')
print('1000 comparisons with a per-step oracle and boundary checks passed')
